description:
HappyDinker Affiliate Program Information

Brand Introduction
HappyDinker is a vibrant pickleball community brand dedicated to promoting positivity, growth, and connection through the sport of pickleball. We celebrate the joy of the game while encouraging players of all levels to embrace self-improvement, teamwork, and community. Our mission is to spread the "Happy Dinker" spirit—on and off the court—through unique merchandise and exciting events that unite and inspire the pickleball community.

Product Description
HappyDinker offers a unique line of pickleball-inspired streetwear and clothing that lets players show their love for the game in style, both on and off the court. Our collection includes comfortable, high-quality apparel that’s perfect for daily wear and designed with a modern twist on pickleball culture. From bold graphic tees and cozy hoodies to stylish caps, each piece reflects the fun, vibrant spirit of the sport and the positivity that HappyDinker stands for. Our merchandise isn’t just gear; it’s a lifestyle choice for those who embrace the energy and growth mindset of pickleball.

USP (Unique Selling Point)
HappyDinker stands out as a brand that goes beyond just selling pickleball merch. We foster a community rooted in positivity and personal growth, making every product a statement of this mission. With HappyDinker, players don’t just wear gear—they wear a mindset. Affiliates have the unique opportunity to represent a brand that resonates with players who want to improve themselves, connect with others, and spread joy on the court.

Payment Terms

  • Commission: Affiliates earn a competitive commission on each sale generated through their referral links or discount codes.
  • Payout Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly via PayPal or bank transfer, with a minimum payout threshold of $50.
  • Bonuses: Additional bonuses are available for top-performing affiliates and those reaching specific monthly sales milestones.

Other Information

  • Marketing Resources: Affiliates gain access to exclusive marketing materials, including branded images, social media captions, and promotional videos that make it easy to share HappyDinker with their audience.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Affiliates can offer a special discount code to their followers, making it more enticing for new customers to join the HappyDinker community.
  • Community and Support: Affiliates are part of the HappyDinker family and are encouraged to participate in events, share feedback, and stay connected with our growing community of pickleball enthusiasts.
